thesis: The closest this desk has come to flipping a call without doing it. Ether took $197M of ETF inflows last week while bitcoin funds bled $463M - the rotation I flagged on 11 September is now unambiguous - and ETH holds the top score in the book at +0.85 with a 55-day breakout. My trigger was a close above 2,700 and price is 2,548. Conviction drops to 0.45 to say I am nearly persuaded; the trigger does not move to meet the price.
bull_case:
Pattern analyst: setup is a **breakout from base** - 55-day high, close 2,548.26, RSI 57 with plenty of room, 63d momentum +43.4%, and 24.2% below the 252-day high, so there is no overhead exhaustion. Squeeze 0.94, neutral; ATR 3.7% is manageable for crypto. No benchmark exists in the table for the crypto sleeve, so rs is unavailable rather than merely empty. Verdict: pattern supports entry now - this is the cleanest structure in the book.

Flows have flipped decisively: $197M into spot ETH ETFs last week against $463M out of bitcoin funds, after a $189.15M single day - the largest since October 2025 - and $1.85B the prior month. Today's packet gives ETH the joint-highest news tone at +0.75, and the position is +2.0%.
bear_case: The trigger I set is not met, and the reason I set it above the fight is that $2,550 has rejected ETH repeatedly - it is trading at 2,548 right now, against that ceiling again. Tomorrow's CLARITY Act vote is described by analysts as simultaneously dead and alive until it happens, and the FOMC follows on Wednesday with hike odds nobody agrees on. Buying the top score in the book the day before two binaries is how the 17% crypto win rate got made. The structural L2 fee-leakage argument that has capped ETH under $3,000 all year is untouched by any of this. Macro, once for the day: the FOMC decides Wednesday 16 September and the odds are genuinely contested - Kalshi showed 48% for a 25bp hike while another tracker had the market-implied probability at 83%, so the single most consequential number this week is one nobody agrees on. The CLARITY Act reaches a Senate vote tomorrow, 15 September, on a revised bill with White House-backed ethics concessions. On energy, Iran and Oman have agreed a **temporary** shipping route lasting two to four months that explicitly does not constitute a full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4%, Sharpe -0.15, 17% win rate over 75 trades. Desk record (research/outcomes.json): 11 closed trades, 0 wins, -$148.09 realised, expectancy -2.84% per trade; long memos are now 3 good of 7 judged, a 0.43 hit rate - below a coin flip. The one long memo the engine acted on, NVDA on 6 September, was stopped out at -8.5%. Conviction is capped accordingly and nothing today is written above 0.65.
catalysts: Whether ETH can close through the $2,550 ceiling
Continued spot Ether ETF inflows after $197M last week
risks: $2,550 has rejected multiple attempts and price is there now
Two binaries in two days with no cash to react
Own backtest: 17% win rate in the crypto sleeve
invalidation: The pattern analyst's level is **2,259.44**, the trailing stop carried in the packet. A close below it ends this. The long trigger is unchanged at a daily close above 2,700 with ETF inflows still positive - deliberately not lowered toward spot, for the third day running.
